current_activity: LXXIV Corps under Straube cannot plug the gaps opened by the US 28th Division attack at Hürtgen
notes: Event date: CMH Siegfried Line Campaign ch. 15 p. 353: "The situation, the chief of staff said, was critical: the LXXIV Corps had not enough men even to plug the gaps already opened"; "Directing the LXXIV Corps commander, General Straube, to return to his post". Event definition: the day of the US 28th Division attack, 2 November. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Hürtgen with a precision of 10 km; the corps chief of staff reported by telephone while the commander was at a map exercise near Cologne. Location approximate: a town point for the corps sector. Location support: CMH names the Hürtgen sector. Commander: General Straube. Opponents: US V Corps (28th Infantry Division). Review (German Batch 3 follow-up, 28 October 2026, requested by Scott; inferred value; old value: operation_id OP-SIEGFRIED-LINE; new value: operation_id OP-HUERTGEN): the claim is a Huertgen Forest action (ch. 15 p. 353) inside the window of OP-HUERTGEN (2 November-14 December 1944), so the narrower battle replaces the broader operation.
